html: The back button navigates back in the app's history when clicked. It is only displayed when there is history in the navigation stack, unless defaultHref is set. The back button displays different text and icon based on the mode, but this can be customized.

This can be customized per back button component by setting the icon or text properties. Alternatively, it can be set globally using the backButtonIcon or backButtonText properties in the global config. Refer to the Config docs for more information.
